newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi three-month T-Bill rate rises to 20.36 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi three-month T-Bill rate rises to 20.36 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills rose to 20.36 per cent at the latest fortnightly tender from 19.35 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Tuesday.
Applications for 91.31 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 90.01 kwacha at the average price of 95.01 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills went up by 0.60 percent to 19.85 percent from 19.25 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 43.4 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 90.32 kwacha percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate dropped by 0.33 percent to 20.65 from 20.98 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 70.02 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 85.15 kwacha percent.
